jobs.title: Site Reliability Engineer Intern
jobs.description: Join Netflix cloud infrastructure team to build automated fault tolerance systems.

jobs.title: Full Stack Developer Intern (MERN)
jobs.description: Join Razorpay's core payments infrastructure team as a Full Stack Developer Intern. You will design, develop, and maintain high-volume merchant-facing portals and RESTful microservices processing millions of daily transactions.
responsibilities: Build reusable and responsive React components for merchant dashboards
Develop secure and scalable Node.js/Express REST APIs
Optimize MongoDB aggregation queries and schema indexing
Collaborate with senior software engineers on code reviews and CI/CD pipelines
requirements: Solid knowledge of JavaScript ES6+, React, Node.js, and MongoDB
Understanding of RESTful APIs, HTTP protocols, and async programming
Familiarity with Git version control and modern web tooling
Pursuing B.Tech/B.E. in Computer Science or related degree (2025/2026/2027 batch)

jobs.title: Cloud & Backend Engineering Intern
jobs.description: Work with Microsoft Azure Cloud team on developer toolchains, containerization services, and resilient distributed backend microservices.
responsibilities: Architect and implement RESTful backend endpoints in Express and Node.js
Integrate MongoDB and document storage with multi-region failover
Write comprehensive unit and integration tests with 90%+ code coverage
Assist in automated CI/CD pipeline deployments to Azure Kubernetes Service
requirements: Proficient in Node.js, Express.js, TypeScript or JavaScript
Knowledge of database design and CRUD principles (MongoDB / SQL)
Strong analytical and algorithmic problem-solving skills
Pre-final or final year engineering student

jobs.title: Frontend React & UI/UX Developer Intern
jobs.description: Help build Swiggy's consumer web applications, customer checkout flows, and hyper-local tracking experience using modern React, smooth animations, and responsive styling.
responsibilities: Convert Figma and design tokens into pixel-perfect, responsive React views
Enhance Core Web Vitals and optimize page rendering times
Implement accessible (a11y) components tested across all major browsers
Connect frontend components with backend REST APIs
requirements: Deep understanding of modern React (hooks, context, lifecycle)
Strong command over HTML5, CSS3, Flexbox, Grid, and responsive design
Hands-on experience with API consumption using Fetch/Axios
Portfolio or GitHub projects demonstrating UI skills
perks: Free meals and snacks on campus

jobs.title: AI & Machine Learning Research Intern
jobs.description: Collaborate with Google Research India on generative AI applications, intelligent document analysis, and natural language understanding models.
responsibilities: Train, fine-tune, and evaluate deep learning architectures on real-world datasets
Develop Python and Node.js microservices to serve model inference endpoints
Build interactive dashboard prototypes to visualize model metrics
Document findings and co-author technical reports
requirements: Strong foundations in Linear Algebra, Probability, and Machine Learning
Proficient in Python, NumPy, Pandas, and PyTorch or TensorFlow
Experience with REST APIs and database handling
Enrolled in B.Tech, M.Tech, or Dual Degree program
perks: Chance to publish in top conferences
Direct consideration for full-time SWE role

jobs.title: Product Design & UI/UX Intern
jobs.description: Design delightful dining, delivery, and quick commerce interfaces. You will participate in user interviews, build design system tokens, and collaborate with React developers.
responsibilities: Create high-fidelity wireframes, interactive user flows, and Figma components
Conduct usability tests and iterate based on real feedback
Maintain and expand the company design system library
Partner with frontend engineers to ensure design fidelity in production
requirements: Demonstrated portfolio showcasing web/mobile UI design and UX thinking
Fluency in Figma, Auto Layout, Components, and interactive prototyping
Basic understanding of HTML and CSS limitations and capabilities
Excellent communication and empathy for users
perks: Design mentorship from VP of Design

jobs.title: Data Analytics & Business Intelligence Intern
jobs.description: Deliver actionable business insights for Fortune 500 clients by querying complex datasets, building automated reporting pipelines, and creating executive dashboards.
responsibilities: Write optimized SQL and MongoDB aggregation queries to extract KPIs
Build dynamic PowerBI and web-based data dashboards
Clean, transform, and validate structured and unstructured data feeds
Present weekly analytical summaries to consulting managers
requirements: Solid SQL and data manipulation fundamentals
Working knowledge of Python (Pandas) and data visualization tools
Good presentation and analytical storytelling abilities
Open to students from Engineering, Maths, or Economics
perks: Hybrid flexibility (3 days work from home)

jobs.title: Mobile App Engineer (React Native) Intern
jobs.description: Craft ultra-smooth animations, fluid gestures, and secure financial user journeys for millions of high-trust CRED users on iOS and Android.
responsibilities: Implement fluid 60fps micro-interactions with Reanimated and React Native
Integrate secure biometric authentication and payment gateway hooks
Optimize memory usage and app launch performance
Write automated end-to-end integration tests
requirements: Hands-on experience with React or React Native
Strong JavaScript / TypeScript fundamentals
Eye for high aesthetic standards and typography
Self-driven problem solver with demonstrable apps on Play Store or GitHub
perks: Work with India's top product engineers

jobs.title: DevOps & Cloud Infrastructure Intern
jobs.description: Support AWS platform reliability engineers in building automated deployment pipelines, infrastructure as code templates, and monitoring observability stacks.
responsibilities: Automate deployment workflows using GitHub Actions and AWS CodePipeline
Configure Docker containers and Helm charts for Kubernetes clusters
Implement CloudWatch alarms, Prometheus metrics, and Grafana dashboards
Troubleshoot network routing, security groups, and SSL certificate renewals
requirements: Familiarity with Linux command line, bash scripting, and networking fundamentals
Understanding of containerization concepts with Docker
Basic programming ability in Node.js or Python
Passion for cloud automation and site reliability engineering
